Agent Name: ScientificPaperAnalysis_Expert  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The first mistake was in step 1, where the agent assumed the paper was on arXiv and attempted an `arxiv_search` using the paper title. The search returned an unrelated paper, showing that this was not a valid route for locating the target University of Leicester paper. This set the conversation on an incorrect path, because the target paper was not an arXiv paper and the later steps continued to rely on a hypothetical PDF instead of the actual source needed to compute the fish bag volume.
